attribution.title: Silodam
attribution.author: Map Recall
attribution.modifications: Original texture-free low-poly reconstruction rebuilt from MVRDV primary exterior photographs and the supplied SketchUp thumbnail as visual references only. No imported SketchUp/Warehouse geometry or photo textures. Native mapped parent and three building parts retain the ten-storey 20m-deep housing, 29m flat roof, open piles, and separate mapped 3–7m projecting office/public balcony. Four distinct facade neighbourhoods include continuous red gallery strips, yellow-framed double-height glass, corrugated silver cladding, large white-framed lower panes, and orange-base cladding represented by the shared warm-gold project palette. Exact current BAG/OSM identities suppress only this building; neighboring historic silos remain.
